title.zh-CN: 简洁更新与 Beta / 正式版同步检查
title.en-US: Compact updates with Beta and stable checks

summary.zh-CN: Beta：打开更新窗口即检查 Beta 与正式版，有新版点击更新即可自动完成下载、校验与重启
summary.en-US: Beta: check Beta and stable releases when opening updates, then update with one click to download, verify and restart

zh-CN: 点击检查程序更新立即同时检查 Beta 与正式版，两行分别显示结果，无需选择通道
有新版时点击对应行的更新，先处理未保存的修改，再自动下载、校验并重启更新
进度与取消留在同一个紧凑窗口中，正式版暂未提供更新包时显示暂无更新
连接方式与启动自动检查放在默认折叠的连接设置中，默认继续自动检测并选择有效线路
en-US: Check Beta and stable releases immediately in two rows without choosing a channel
Click Update on an available release, resolve unsaved edits, then download, verify and restart automatically
Keep progress and cancellation in the compact window, and show that no stable update is available when its slot is empty
Place connection and automatic-check preferences in collapsed connection settings while keeping automatic route selection

title.zh-CN: 保留文件保护与使用说明
title.en-US: Keep file protection and usage guidance

zh-CN: 继续校验发布签名与更新文件，失败时切换线路，原位置替换前保留旧程序备份，启动失败时尝试恢复
使用统一递增构建号防止降级，自动检查只提示新版本，安装由用户主动选择
README 专注功能、操作与兼容范围，移除程序下载方式、源码构建命令和验证结果
离线公告仅包含当前 r9 说明，在线公告保留此前版本历史
en-US: Retain release and file checks, route fallback, executable backups and recovery when the new app fails to start
Prevent downgrades with increasing build numbers; automatic checks only notify, while installation requires an Update click
Focus the README on features, usage and compatibility instead of download instructions, build commands or validation results
Bundle only this r9 build note offline while retaining earlier online announcements
